claims.statement: Rule and Fact input planes remain distinct from the deterministic Guide control plane and from MethodRef knowledge inputs; effective Direction resolves to declared Rule authority.
claims.falsified_by: a conforming projection treats Guide, Fact, or MethodRef material as independent authorizing Rule authority

claims.statement: Direction for a task-conditioned Candidate contains a source-complete atomic acceptance ledger with explicit scope, decision Rules, typed relations, and separate definition, applicability, coverage, and assessment states.
claims.falsified_by: a conforming Candidate silently drops a public normative clause, invents precedence, or collapses ledger definition, applicability, coverage, and assessment into one status

claims.statement: A declared task work backlog is an immutable, acyclic execution projection whose stable rows bind the complete acceptance-ID set to dependencies, task scope, done-when conditions, selected capability IDs, and advisory reminders without creating authority.
claims.falsified_by: a conforming backlog contains dangling or cyclic rows, omits an acceptance item, changes success semantics, or treats row state as permission or proof of acceptance

claims.statement: Reusable capability modules bind exact mechanics, contracts, applicability, side effects, version, and digest while excluding task answers and post-outcome learning; reportable experiments freeze the capability pack before scored task exposure.
claims.scope: reusable domain mechanics and construction experiments
claims.falsified_by: a reusable module embeds task-specific solution data, hides mutating effects, changes after task exposure, or is identified only by a mutable name or branch

claims.statement: A runner-held hash-linked Position timeline projects the same current row, bounded capabilities, and replayable advisory reminders for Worker and QA; the projection cannot rewrite frozen Rules, synthesize completion evidence, authorize mutation, or block external evaluation.
claims.scope: task runtime, Worker, and independent QA
claims.falsified_by: Worker and QA receive different row projections, reminders become undeclared Gates, or timeline events silently rewrite frozen acceptance, work, or capability definitions

claims.statement: A bounded single-task experiment uses one total deadline across logical role handoffs and monotonically preserves complete Worker submissions; cooperative role labels are provenance rather than credentials, QA assessments are separate, the selected latest reference is exact, and a fully prevalidated restore uses truthfully reported per-file atomic replacement before external scoring.
claims.scope: bounded task execution, repair, QA, and external scoring handoff
claims.falsified_by: a phase-local hard cutoff discards a complete submission, incomplete later work replaces the newest complete Worker revision, latest disagrees with its manifest, restore mutates before full prevalidation, per-file replacement is described as a whole-set transaction, QA suppresses fallback or scoring, or cooperative role labels are claimed as security enforcement

claims.statement: Rule is the normative authority layer; Contract is only a versioned Rule-closure container or binding, and any declared Gate, Guide, and Entrance share one coherent Rule closure, Fact root, role/scope, world, warranties, and verdict.
claims.scope: Rule transitions and optional Gate projections
claims.falsified_by: a conforming Gate invents authority, evaluates an orphan predicate, repairs a conflict locally, or creates a downstream evidence demand that no earlier legal transition can satisfy

claims.statement: Method objects are semantic roles and proof obligations rather than mandatory services, agents, modules, files, schema fields, or deployment topology; conformance is semantic and evidential equivalence.
claims.falsified_by: conformance requires copying a named source system, module layout, service boundary, or field vocabulary despite an equivalent canonical projection

claims.statement: Construction experiments preserve incomplete closure as observable nonblocking outcomes, whereas a separately declared long-lived-system profile may enforce Gates only after Rule authority, conformance, and whole-chain coherence are established.
claims.scope: experimental intervention design and stable governed systems
claims.falsified_by: a construction experiment silently adds blocking Gates or a governed-system Gate is treated as valid without its declared Rule and satisfiable chain

claims.statement: An authorized no-PASS bypass may linearly expose downstream Gate defects while preserving one diagnostic root, but a bypass never establishes PASS or C.
claims.scope: recovery in the long-lived governed-system profile
claims.falsified_by: a bypass is reported as proof of conformance or current C, or dependent downstream bypasses lose their shared diagnostic root

claims.statement: Independent QA receives the same frozen Corridor as the executor, independently re-reads public task sources, accounts for every acceptance ID, and requires a replayable witness for a concrete failure.
claims.falsified_by: QA assesses a different Corridor, treats witness repair as whole-task closure, reports fail without a replayable acceptance witness, or reports pass with incomplete source coverage

claims.statement: A Candidate has one bounded semantic Entrance and exact profile-declared world identity even when both have several physical projections.
claims.falsified_by: a certificate combines undeclared entrance identities or relies on an ambient, mutable, or moving-target world reference

claims.statement: Repair re-enters U to scope-indexed C only through a new frozen Candidate, fresh traversal, PathCertificate, and live EvidentialWarranty without rewriting history.
claims.falsified_by: constructing or bypassing a Candidate is treated as C, or evidence from separate revisions is spliced into one certificate or warranty

claims.statement: TraversalReceipt, PathCertificate, Independent QA, and the exactly two Warranty kinds remain distinct evidence propositions; none is minted solely from another.
claims.falsified_by: one evidence surface automatically establishes another, or a score, log, or QA verdict is promoted to a certificate, Warranty, authority, or C

claims.statement: P, D, and E are conditioned on role, world, datum, and history and may only be factorized as a conditional chain; run or scenario remains the primary clustered experimental unit.
claims.falsified_by: marginal rates are multiplied or decision events and roles are treated as independent experimental units

claims.statement: Method-grounded diagnosis classifies the violated invariant as P, D, or E, records authorized-action execution failure separately as X, and remains advisory rather than minting authority, warranty, or an empirical result.
claims.falsified_by: diagnosis classifies only by the component that surfaced a failure or is treated as authorization, warranty, estimator, or causal evidence
